data.title: 在原七海 · 为两人准备的晚餐
data.description: 七海把最后一只碗放到桌上，发现筷子的方向摆反了，又转回来。你伸手帮忙时，她轻声说：“坐下吧，今天我们慢慢吃。”
data.action: setting two bowls on a dining table
data.promptProse: In a warmly lit dining room, Nanami carefully arranges two porcelain bowls on the wooden dining table before dinner. The soft glow from the overhead lamp illuminates the steam rising from the dishes, while the blurred reflection of the kitchen lights in the background enhances the quiet, intimate atmosphere of their evening meal.
data.animaCaption: Two place settings are ready for their dinner together.
